title: nephrodium cyatheoides
intro: Nephrodium cyatheoides, commonly known as the "Cyathea fern", is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the Cyatheaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties. Nephrodium cyatheoides has been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are beneficial for treating wounds, skin conditions, and other ailments. The therapeutic actions of this plant include antimicrobial and antiparasitic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
